name: unit-health
description: Unit Health CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `validate` domain: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the ValidationService proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Validate a scenario's test execution, coverage, architecture, quality, and local test maturity

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to validate instead of a scenario slug

flags.name: workspace
flags.description: Restrict validation to a workspace id (repeatable)

flags.name: execution
flags.description: Execute planned test commands (default: plan only)

flags.name: fast-test-only
flags.description: Execute only the fast test command and omit coverage artifacts

flags.name: reviewed-cohort
flags.description: Attach a sampled-review cohort id to the validation receipt

flags.name: reviewed-source-identity
flags.description: Source identity for the attached sampled-review cohort

flags.name: reviewed-observation-count
flags.description: Number of observed labels in the attached sampled-review cohort

commands.name: test-body
commands.description: Read one bounded redacted test body for sampled review

flags.name: max-bytes
flags.description: Excerpt ceiling, capped by the owner at 4096 bytes

groups.name: calibrate
groups.description: Compare the governed test-quality corpus with adapter observations

commands.name: corpus
commands.description: Show the authored calibration corpus inventory

commands.name: pilot
commands.description: Apply bounded Go mutations in cache copies and run owning tests

flags.name: package
flags.description: Go package pattern relative to the workspace

flags.name: max-mutants
flags.description: Maximum mutants, capped by the owner at 50
